name: Exp_ForecastOscilator
summary: This EA trades based on the ForecastOscilator custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward oscillator signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals. The strategy is a signal-based momentum system with optional reverse-signal exit logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ForecastOscilator自定义指标进行交易，在指标上穿信号时开多仓，下穿信号时开空仓。支持多种资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及独立的入场和出场信号开关。策略属于基于信号的动量系统，带有反向信号出场逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ForecastOscilator振荡器指标的信号判断，该指标通过T3平滑算法和可配置的长度参数生成趋势动量信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区3（上穿信号）有效时触发买入开仓，缓冲区2（下穿信号）有效时触发卖出开仓，每个方向的开仓和信号检测可独立开关控制。出场条件包含两种逻辑：一是反向信号出场（买入平仓由下穿信号触发，卖出平仓由上穿信号触发），二是止损止盈出场。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库实现，支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含亏损的自由保证金比例、含亏损的余额比例和固定手数。资金管理方面，MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%，配合MMMode选择具体计算方式。出场逻辑中还有一个历史回溯机制：当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线查找更早的反向信号以决定是否平仓，这增加了策略的灵活性但也增加了回测与实盘的一致性风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ForecastOscilator custom indicator, which generates trend momentum signals using a T3 smoothing algorithm with configurable length and volume factor parameters. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 3 (upward crossover signal) is valid, a buy position is opened; when buffer 2 (downward crossover signal) is valid, a sell position is opened, with each direction's entry and signal detection independently toggleable. Exit conditions include two mechanisms: reverse-signal exits (buy close triggered by downward signal, sell close triggered by upward signal) and stop loss/take profit exits. Position sizing is handled via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library supporting five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio (default 0.1 = 10%) combined with MMMode to select the specific calculation method. The exit logic includes a historical lookback mechanism: when both entry and exit are enabled but no current exit signal exists, the EA traverses historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for exit decisions, adding flexibility but also introducing backtest-vs-live consistency risks.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/含亏损保证金/含亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin / balance / margin w/ loss / balance w/ loss / fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号）

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算使用的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type used for indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引（0=当前bar，1=已完成bar）
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal judgment (0 = current, 1 = completed)

pros: 独立的入场和出场开关设计灵活，可以仅使用信号入场而用止损止盈出场，或仅用信号平仓而不开新仓
支持五种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
使用已完成的K线（SignalBar=1）进行信号判断，避免当前bar信号闪烁导致的重复交易
止损和止盈参数独立配置，风险控制明确
新bar检测机制避免同一根K线内重复处理信号
pros_en: Independent entry and exit toggles provide flexibility — can use signal-only entries with SL/TP exits, or signal-only exits without new entries
Five money management modes accommodate different risk preferences
Uses confirmed bar (SignalBar=1) for signal detection, avoiding repainting and repeated trades from current bar flickering
Separate stop loss and take profit parameters give clear risk control boundaries
New bar detection via CIsNewBar prevents redundant signal processing within the same bar
cons: 历史回溯遍历K线查找反向信号的逻辑复杂且可能造成回测与实盘行为不一致，实盘中历史信号可能在后续bar上才被发现
依赖外部自定义指标ForecastOscilator和TradeAlgorithms库，缺少这些文件EA将无法运行，可移植性差
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高点差时段或非活跃时段可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，对不同品种需要大幅调整，缺乏自适应机制
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: The historical bar lookback logic for finding reverse signals is complex and may cause backtest-vs-live inconsistency, as historical signals may only be discovered on subsequent bars in live trading
Depends on external custom indicator ForecastOscilator and TradeAlgorithms library — without these files the EA cannot run, hurting portability
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially executing trades during high-spread or illiquid periods
Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are excessively large for many instruments and lack adaptive sizing
No existing position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认当前没有同方向持仓，避免重复开仓
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利条件下的成交
移除或简化历史K线回溯出场逻辑，改为仅使用当前bar信号判断出场，提高回测与实盘一致性
improvements_en: Add position check logic before opening trades to confirm no existing same-direction positions, preventing duplicate entries
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable execution conditions
Remove or simplify the historical bar lookback exit logic, using only current bar signal for exit decisions to improve backtest-vs-live consistency

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致过度集中风险
历史K线回溯出场逻辑在实盘中可能表现与回测不一致
默认止损止盈点数过大，未对品种波动率做自适应调整
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate entries and over-concentrated risk
Historical bar lookback exit logic may behave inconsistently between backtesting and live trading
Default SL/TP point values are very large without instrument-specific volatility adaptation
